assertions: Exactly two native OfficeArt shapes: picture id1025 and AutoShape id1026, rectangle text CF_SHAPE_005, A12:B17/F16:H20 anchors and move/resize behavior; no invented group children.
tests.scope_limit: BIFF drawing shape projection only; this test does not resolve image payloads, preserve full OfficeArt geometry or author shapes.

tests.name: native_drawing_picture_and_rectangle_keep_resolved_payload_and_anchors
assertions: Two anchored objects, one resolved PNG with exact hash and native name/alt text/rId1, exact cell anchor endpoints, and one named RoundRect with CF_SHAPE_005 text; drawings_parsed confirms the eager inventory.
tests.scope_limit: Floating drawing image scope only; in-cell rich-value bindings and SVG lifecycle are not inferred. No rendering, external resolution or shape editing.

tests.name: native_query_table_catalog_follows_both_worksheet_and_table_owners
assertions: Exactly one query table on each native sheet: table-owned ExternalData_1/connection2 with ID,Category,Amount field bindings and direct LEGACY_CSV_010/connection1. No-op archive bytes stay exact.
tests.scope_limit: Stored query-table ownership and metadata only; no imports, provider activation or refresh.

tests.name: native_connections_expose_text_import_and_inert_mashup_metadata
assertions: Two validated native connections, exact Text code page/path/comma flags/field count and OleDb provider/command/keep-alive metadata; both query-table parts admitted through their actual owners.
tests.scope_limit: Paths and commands remain inert. Query definitions are not evaluated and the DataMashup payload is not interpreted.

tests.name: native_external_link_keeps_alternate_url_and_cached_sheets
assertions: Exact relative primary and absolute alternate target, three source sheet names, and cached Sheet1 D6=49.75 / Sheet2 B4=14 with row/sheet indices. The declared ignorable extension remains typed.
tests.scope_limit: Cached external data and relationship strings only; no link resolution, fetching or recalculation.

tests.name: native_query_table_rename_keeps_table_bindings_revisions_and_legacy_import
assertions: Native worksheet- and table-owned query-table names change by exactly one source substitution, preserving revision UID/MCE declarations, field bindings and every other package member. Temporary save/reopen and inverse restore all original member bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Name-only replacement is source-preserving. Whole-definition replacements retain canonical writer semantics; table-owned removal/reorder or field rebinding requires separate table conversion and returns Unsupported. ZIP compression identity after inverse is not promised.

tests.name: native_connection_description_edit_keeps_import_data_and_mashup_payloads
assertions: Edit connection2 description, reopen the native graph, preserve all other members including query parts, imported rows and DataMashup, and restore every member byte through inverse.
tests.scope_limit: Inert metadata edit only; no refresh or credential use. Member-level restoration does not assert identical ZIP compression.

tests.name: native_alternate_url_metadata_edit_preserves_both_inert_targets_and_caches
assertions: Add driveId to the native alternate URL owner, retain both targets and exact cached values, preserve all other members, and restore exact original member bytes through source-image inverse replay.
tests.scope_limit: No target access or live service identity validation. Full ZIP archive identity is separate from this part-level patch contract.

tests.name: native_connection_owner_creation_removal_and_inverse_preserve_original_members
assertions: Copy inert typed Text connection metadata into a native workbook with no connection owner, save/reopen id7, remove the last connection, and invert both lifecycle patches with every original member byte restored, including content types and workbook relationships.
tests.scope_limit: The original external links, rich values, embedded document and caches remain inert. No query execution, target access, native Office reopen or whole-ZIP byte identity claim.

tests.name: native_text_import_connection_exposes_the_stored_property_block
assertions: Exact classic text-import path, encoding selectors (fallback WindowsAnsi/app45), delimiter/qualifier/prompt flags, first row, separators, ignored bit and three General fields; six opaque UID-wrapper records retain their root positions. OleDb provider/command metadata is exact.
tests.scope_limit: Encoding selectors are stored values, not an executed decoder. Classic text metadata only; model-data-source Text15 and query-table payloads remain opaque. Common data_file/connection_file are correctly absent; the path belongs to text-import properties.

tests.name: native_connection_description_edit_keeps_text_records_in_their_original_scope
assertions: Edit only connection2 description; every record except its common header remains byte-exact and in order, including connection1 ignored password byte and UID wrappers. Temporary save/reopen and inverse retain every package member and original source bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Inert metadata only; no refresh or target access. Package-member restoration does not claim identical ZIP compression.

tests.name: native_text_options_and_fields_edit_without_changing_cached_import_rows
assertions: Change comma to semicolon and Category field type to Text. Exactly the text-import header and second field record change; all query, worksheet, table and DataMashup members remain exact. Reopen reads the new options and inverse restores all original members.
tests.scope_limit: Stored import instructions only; cached imported rows are not recalculated, decoded again or refreshed.

tests.name: native_text_field_add_remove_is_reversible_and_root_identity_order_is_guarded
assertions: Add a fourth Skip field, reopen, remove it and recover the original members; inverse also restores them. Reordering connections around opaque root identities and removing connections with query-table dependencies return precise UnsupportedFeature errors without source mutation.
tests.scope_limit: Field-list metadata lifecycle only; source topology changes around opaque records and query dependency teardown remain unsupported. Query-table parts themselves are not typed by this test.

tests.name: native_external_workbook_cache_exposes_both_source_cells_without_accessing_target
assertions: External then self supporting books, exact encoded virtual path, three source sheet names, three references, absent external names and exact Sheet1 D6=49.75/Sheet2 B4=14 caches with zero-based row/column coordinates; Sheet1 remains visible.
tests.scope_limit: Read-only external metadata/cache projection. No external target access, refresh, formula evaluation or public external-link transaction claim.
